$comment: Player imagery for Game Script cards (REVIEW ASSETS, temporary until a licensed player-image source is chosen). One entry per player: `team`, `role` (lead = QB, skill = RB/WR), the publication's `participant_id`, and the Wikimedia Commons `category` to search. Pin a reviewed frame as `commons_file` (+ `focus`); scripts/players/fetch.mjs then downloads pinned files only (free licences, credited). Unpinned players get a contact sheet under curation/players/.
